{{nihongo|'''Ogushi Shrine'''|小梳神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Suruga Province]].

'''Ogushi Shrine''' (おぐしじんじゃ) is a shrine in Kōya-machi, {{ill|Aoi-ku, Shizuoka|ar|أوي-كو|ceb|Aoi-ku|fa|آئویی-کو، شیزوئوکا|fr|Aoi-ku|id|Aoi-ku, Shizuoka|it|Aoi-ku|ja|葵区|ko|아오이구|tr|Aoi|uk|Район Аой|ur|آوی وارڈ، شیزوکا|zh|葵區|qid=Q1131483}}, {{ill|Shizuoka (city)|an|Shizuoka|ar|شيزوكا (مدينة)|arz|شيزوكا (مدينه)|ast|Shizuoka|az|Şizuoka|azb|شیزوئوکا|ban|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|be|Сідзуока (горад)|bg|Шидзуока (град)|br|Shizuoka|ca|Shizuoka|ce|Сидзуока (гӀала)|ceb|Shizuoka-shi (distrito)|cs|Šizuoka|da|Shizuoka|de|Shizuoka|eo|Ŝizuoko|es|Shizuoka|et|Shizuoka|eu|Shizuoka|fa|شیزوئوکا|fi|Shizuoka|fj|Shizuoka|fr|Shizuoka|ga|Shizuoka|gl|Shizuoka|he|שיזואוקה|hi|शिज़ूओका|hu|Sizuoka (település)|hy|Սիձուոկա|id|Shizuoka|is|Shizuoka|it|Shizuoka|ja|静岡市|ka|სიძუოკა|ki|Shizuoka|ko|시즈오카시|lt|Šidzuoka (miestas)|lv|Šidzuoka|mdf|Сидзуока (ошсь)|mg|Shizuoka|mn|Шизүока|mr|शिझुओका|ms|Shizuoka|mzn|شیزوئوکا (شهر)|nl|Shizuoka (stad)|no|Shizuoka|os|Сидзуокæ (сахар)|pl|Shizuoka|pms|Shizuoka|pt|Shizuoka (cidade)|ro|Shizuoka|ru|Сидзуока (город)|sah|Сидзуока|sc|Shizuoka|sco|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|sh|Shizuoka|simple|Shizuoka (city)|sk|Šizuoka|sr|Шизуока|su|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|sv|Shizuoka|sw|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|tg|Шизуока|th|ชิซูโอกะ (นคร)|tl|Shizuoka|tok|ma tomo Sisujoka|tr|Şizuoka|tt|Сидзуока (шәһәр)|tum|Shizuoka|uk|Сідзуока|ur|شیزوکا|uz|Shizuoka|vep|Sidzuok (lidn)|vi|Shizuoka (thành phố)|war|Shizuoka (syudad)|wuu|静冈市|zh|靜岡市|zh_classical|靜岡市|zh_min_nan|Sizuoka-chhī|zh_yue|靜岡市|qid=Q174691}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4406004 小梳神社] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined just northwest of the north exit of JR {{ill|Shizuoka Station|arz|محطة شيزوكا|de|Bahnhof Shizuoka|eo|Stacio Shizuoka|fr|Gare de Shizuoka|id|Stasiun Shizuoka|it|Stazione di Shizuoka|ja|静岡駅|jv|Setatsiyun Shizuoka|ko|시즈오카역|pl|Shizuoka (stacja kolejowa)|ru|Сидзуока (станция)|su|Stasion Shizuoka|tr|Şizuoka İstasyonu|ur|شیزوکا اسٹیشن|zh|靜岡站|qid=Q801440}}, on the north side along Gofuku-chō-dōri.

Its foundation is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified with a same-named {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}<ref name="oz">[https://humizuki.com/omaturi_zanmai/sight/jinja/sizuoka/ogusi.htm 小梳神社] - Omatsuri Zanmai</ref><ref name="genbu">[https://genbu.net/data/suruga/ogusi_title.htm 小梳神社] - Genshōshi</ref>.

It is also called Shōshōinomiya and was revered by the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Imagawa clan}}<ref name="s-kanko2">[https://www.visit-shizuoka.com/t/oogosho400/study/07_05.htm 紺屋町と少将井社〔小梳神社〕と代官屋敷] - Suruga Planning and Tourism Bureau</ref>.

It is also known as a shrine where the young {{ill|Tokugawa Ieyasu|Q171977|qid=Q171977}} (Takechiyo) prayed for lasting martial fortune. It once stood at the castle deputy’s residence in the third bailey of {{ill|Sunpu Castle|de|Burg Sumpu|es|Castillo de Sunpu|eu|Sunpu gaztelua|fa|قلعه سونپو|fr|Château de Sunpu|id|Kastel Sunpu|ja|駿府城|ko|슨푸성|ml|സൺപു കാസിൽ|pt|Castelo de Sunpu|th|ปราสาทซุมปุ|zh|駿府城|qid=Q1038629}} (present Shizuoka City History Museum, formerly Aoba Elementary School), but with expansion of Sunpu Castle in the Edo period it was moved via Araya-machi (present Miyuki-chō to Tenma-chō) to its current site (Kōya-machi)<ref name="s-kanko2"/><ref name="s-kanko">[https://www.visit-shizuoka.com/spots/detail.php?kanko=543#:~:text=%E5%BE%B3%E5%B7%9D%E5%AE%B6%E5%BA%B7%E3%81%AE%E5%B9%BC%E5%B0%91%E6%9C%9F,%E5%BA%87%E8%AD%B7%E3%82%92%E5%8F%97%E3%81%91%E3%81%BE%E3%81%97%E3%81%9F%25E3%2580%2582 小梳神社] - Suruga Planning and Tourism Bureau</ref><ref name="in">[http://www.ieyasu-net.com/shiseki/shizuoka/07shizuokashi/0002.html 小梳神社] - Nationwide Ieyasu Network</ref>.
